title: Croatia Faces Twin Tests of Credibility · 15 Oct
keywords: Croatia, cost of living, fuel price controls, Gospić, hazardous waste, environmental scandal, Andrej Plenković, Croatian opposition, EU environmental law, eurozone, public debt, inflation, waste trafficking, household welfare, Croatian politics
notes: Croatia's government is simultaneously defending its economic record against accusations that price controls mask deeper affordability problems and managing the fallout from a hazardous-waste crisis in Gospić that has provoked parliamentary walkouts and criminal investigations. Together, the two disputes reveal a widening gap between the government's macroeconomic confidence and the daily insecurities felt by ordinary citizens. Both cases carry implications that extend beyond Croatia's borders, touching on EU environmental enforcement and the limits of state intervention in energy markets.
